prompt:

Header text verbatim: "säkerhet". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "safety".
Scene: Construction workers wearing hard hats and protective vests behind a proper barrier, a simple shield-and-check symbol prominent, no readable signs.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "säkerhet = safety; protection from danger.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Säkerheten är viktig på bygget.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
